resources.string: Live price of XBT, the Bitcoin-BLAKE2b (BIP110) chain, on your home screen.

To add it: long-press your home screen, tap Widgets and pick XBT Widget.

XBT is the coin of the Bitcoin-BLAKE2b chain (BIP110). Poolcoins and Poolsats are the units of the SHA256d majority chain.

Price data from the public xbt.live endpoint, refreshed every 15 minutes, and at most once a minute when you tap refresh. No account, no tracking, no ads.

Not financial advice. Prices come from public exchange data and can be delayed or wrong.
